chain.label: Maintenance manual lacks aft trunnion pin verification step
chain.trigger: Learjet maintenance manual procedures for installing the main landing gear do not contain a step to ensure that the aft trunnion pin is positioned correctly or that the retaining bolt is secured through it

chain.label: Hard bounced landing at McAlester burst both left main tires
chain.trigger: the airplane landed hard just short of the runway surface and bounced several times... both left main landing gear tires burst

chain.label: Aft trunnion pin misinstalled during hard-landing inspection reassembly; retaining bolt secured without passing through pin
chain.trigger: the aft trunnion pin was not correctly installed when the main landing gear was installed... The retaining bolt had been installed and secured in the aft trunnion casting without going through the hole in the aft trunnion pin

caused_by.evidence: The captain hired a mechanic... to perform a hard landing inspection... which included removing both main landing gear to facilitate the required inspections
In the absence of a required verification step, a mechanic could inadvertently install the retaining bolt without it passing through the trunnion pin

chain.label: Left main gear insecurely attached to wing, undetected in service
chain.trigger: the insecure attachment resulting from such misassembly is not readily detectable during routine maintenance or preflight inspections

caused_by.evidence: the retaining bolt prevents the pin from being (correctly) fully inserted into the trunnion... leaving the gear insecurely attached to the airframe

chain.label: Left main gear backed out of trunnion casting and trailed aft on final approach
chain.trigger: an 11-second video showing the airplane on final approach with the left landing gear trailing aft from its normal position

caused_by.evidence: The absence of the aft trunnion pin (which remained intact on the airplane) from the trunnion casting indicated that the retaining bolt was secured to the aft trunnion casting without passing through the aft trunnion pin

chain.label: Left main landing gear separated from wing structure at touchdown
chain.trigger: The left main landing gear separated from the airplane and came to rest... adjacent to taxiway B

caused_by.evidence: installation of the aft trunnion pin without engaging its retaining bolt can result in the landing gear separating from the airplane during landing

chain.label: Left-wing-low attitude and loss of directional control during rollout
chain.trigger: The airplane immediately entered a left-wing-low attitude and began veering left

caused_by.evidence: thereby increasing the risk for loss of directional control and runway excursion

chain.label: Drag chute not deployed and no thrust reversers installed, so no deceleration augmentation
chain.trigger: The airplane was not equipped with thrust reversers and the drag chute was not deployed

chain.label: Airplane departed the left side of runway 21 onto the safety area
chain.trigger: it departed the left side of the runway... The airplane traveled over the rock-covered runway safety areas

caused_by.evidence: began veering left, exiting the runway surface

chain.label: Struck windsock and collided with parked Gulfstream G200 on the ramp
chain.trigger: crossed taxiway B, collided with a windsock, and entered the ramp area where it struck the right side of the parked Gulfstream G200

caused_by.evidence: it departed the left side of the runway and impacted a parked Gulfstream G200
the drag chute serves a similar purpose—helping to reduce landing rollout distance

chain.label: Captain fatally injured; occupants of both airplanes seriously and minorly injured
chain.trigger: The Learjet's captain was fatally injured, the first officer (FO) and one passenger were seriously injured, and one passenger received minor injuries; additionally, an occupant inside the parked airplane... sustained serious injuries

caused_by.evidence: it struck the right side of the parked Gulfstream G200
